captions.text: Start with a tiny corpus. Every word is split into characters.
Phase 1 · COUNT every adjacent pair, weighted by how often its word occurs.
Phase 2 · CHOOSE the most frequent pair: (e, s) occurs 9 times.
Phase 3 · MERGE: replace every (e, s) by the single new symbol “es”.
Repeat. Each merge adds one symbol to the vocabulary and shortens the corpus.
After 6 merges the whole word “newest” is a single token.
